name: webjobs-list

schema.title: JSON schema for Azure Webjobs collection files

description:
Hello team,

Below is the current inventory of our Azure WebJobs along with their respective script locations on the server. The continuous job *JobA* is hosted at **site/wwwroot/App_Data/Jobs/Continuous/JobA/run.csx**, while the triggered job *JobB* resides at **site/wwwroot/App_Data/Jobs/Triggered/JobB/run.ps1**. We also have another continuous job, *JobC*, whose script can be found at **site/wwwroot/App_Data/Jobs/Continuous/JobC/run.js**. Please let me know if any updates are required.
